reviewContext.userProblem: nodetto has no way to lay out solderless-breadboard prototypes: no breadboard page kind, no part catalogue on a 0.1 inch hole grid, no connectivity or electrical rules check, no BOM or netlist export, and no way to build a board against a KiCad schematic or netlist with a ratsnest and parity check.
requiredOutcomes: A 'breadboard' page kind and 13 typed breadboard.* element types (board, wire, resistor, LED, capacitor, diode, transistor, push button, potentiometer, DIP IC, pin header, battery, target netlist card) in packages/ir with validation and a JSONL golden fixture; SCHEMA_VERSION stays 1 (design 3, plan 01).
A fixed original part catalogue with pin tables on BREADBOARD_PITCH = 10, board layouts (full/half/mini, strips a-e/f-j, continuous rails) and pinned core types (design 3.3, 3.4, 4.1, plan 02).
Hole-grid snapping on place/move, 90-degree part rotation (r / Shift+R on breadboard pages only), board carry and automatic reference annotation with duplicate fixing (design 4.2-4.4, 7.4, plan 06).

A connectivity engine deriving nets from strips, rails, wires and pins; net highlight; eight ERC rules (pin-not-in-hole, shorted-part, rail-short, reversed-polarity, led-no-series-resistor, unconnected-pin, duplicate-reference, wire-end-off-hole) in lintBreadboardPage (design 5.1, 5.2, 6, plan 07).

Live ratsnest for unrouted target connections and five schematic-parity rules (parity-missing-connection, parity-extra-connection, parity-missing-part, parity-extra-part, parity-value-mismatch) (design 5.3, 6.1, plan 10).

One shared original notation module for canvas and SVG export, resistor colour bands from value (E-series, 4-band and 5-band, tolerance), LED colours and flat-side mark, IC notch and pin-1 dot (design 7.1, 7.3, plans 08 and 11).
BOM CSV, KiCad-style S-expression netlist and SPICE netlist formatters in packages/io; D2 and Mermaid skip breadboard types gracefully (design 8.1-8.5, plan 03).

Own S-expression reader and KiCad 6+ .kicad_sch and .net importers with symbol mapping and diagnostics, self-authored fixtures under test-fixtures/kicad, @nodetto/io ./kicad subpath export (design 8.6.1-8.6.4, plan 04); staged off-board import layout (design 8.6.5, plan 09).
Collab round trip of a breadboard fixture (plan 05).

UI: breadboard workspace and palette, wire tool, keys, net-highlight and ratsnest overlays (plan 12); inspector reference/value/parameter fields, rotation and net highlight (plan 13); breadboard problems panel with cross-probing (plan 14); BOM/KiCad/SPICE in the ExportDialog (plan 15).
nodetto-cli lint for breadboard pages plus 'breadboard bom|netlist|import' commands (design 9, plan 16).
Desktop: workspace follows page kind, problems panel mount, export dialog wiring, .kicad_sch/.net open as detached imports through the open-dialog filter (design 10, plan 17).
Example examples/breadboard/led-button.jsonl with golden BOM/KiCad/SPICE outputs, KiCad round-trip golden test, docs/breadboard and README section (design 11, plan 18).
Final gate: bun run typecheck, bun test packages, mise run lint and CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run verify pass; ASCII gates over everything the feature added.
nonGoals: Schematic or PCB views; Fritzing file import.
KiCad legacy (KiCad 5 and older) .sch, hierarchical sheets, buses, .kicad_pcb, writing .kicad_sch, back-annotation to KiCad.
Re-import merge into an existing page; editing the stored target netlist in the editor.
OS file associations for .kicad_sch or .net (user-QA Q10).
Simulation; the SPICE file is an export only.
User-defined parts or a part library editor.
Split power rails and board rotation (user-QA Q2).
An ERC config file or per-rule severity overrides.
PNG/PDF-specific changes; native (Rust) awareness of breadboard types.
No SCHEMA_VERSION change or migration; no new npm or cargo dependencies; bun.lock unchanged.
No edits to the stale impl-plans/active/export-*.md or web-app-roundtrip.md plans.
constraints: Follow AGENTS.md; no emojis; ASCII only in new files and added lines (perl gates in the overview).
Public repository: no server code, auth, secrets, endpoints, deployment config or nodetto-cloud content.

License boundary: no code, comments, keyword tables beyond required format tokens, symbols, footprints, demos, QA files, artwork, rule wording or samples from KiCad, Fritzing or any GPL/CC-BY-SA source; .reference/kicad is read-only behaviour reference and never committed; KiCad fixtures are small and hand-written.
Follow the BPMN page-kind precedent for registry, semantics, lint, SVG export, palette, inspector, problems panel and CLI wiring.
Additive only: existing page kinds, element types, fixtures and tests stay unchanged and passing; pinned-list tests are edited only by their owning plan (overview test ownership table).
Strict TypeScript: no any, no @ts-ignore, no non-null assertions on untrusted data; Biome style.
Cargo commands use CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; Rust is formatted only by plan 17.

Branch feat/breadboard-mode only; gitPush=false. Workers perform no git write operations, no worktrees, no stash; the orchestrator commits serially with explicit paths after each wave join and never stages .reference/ or tmp/.

Each worker edits only its writePaths, its sharedPaths per sharedPathNotes, and its own impl-plans/progress/<planId>.md; fresh read plus pre/post sha256 per edit; intent snapshot before first edit; foreground commands only; format only its own files.

Gates G1 (owner-scoped typecheck by ownTypecheckRegex) and G2 (focused owned bun test must pass) are blocking per plan; sibling diagnostics and sibling test failures are recorded as non-blocking; whole-repo gates run at orchestrator reconciliation and are strictly blocking.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Breadboard parts are category node elements, never edges, so connector routing, ports and backdrops never see them; connectivity is derived geometrically from holes and pins (design 3.2, 5.1).
One pitch = 10 page units on a lattice independent of the UI SNAP_GRID = 24 (design 3.1).
Shared pure models needed by both io and core (value parsing, netlist model, import plan and diagnostics) live in packages/ir/src/breadboard.ts because io cannot import core (design 1, plan 01).
The target netlist is a visible, undoable, synced breadboard.netlist card element rather than a typed page field (user-QA Q7).
One shared notation module feeds both the SVG export and the canvas so they cannot diverge (design 7.1, plans 08 and 11).
Plan 08 depends on plan 06 because SVG export bounds come from registry shape utils; wires without visual.width/height need the breadboard shape utils from plan 06 (plan review PR5-1).
Cross-package golden and KiCad round-trip tests live in packages/core, which dev-depends on @nodetto/io, following packages/core/src/bpmn/docs-example.test.ts (overview).
KiCad LED/diode pins are mapped by A/K names so schematic numbering does not matter (user-QA Q1).
Parity severities: merged target nets are errors, others warnings; staged parts are reported by pin-not-in-hole as the work queue (user-QA Q8, Q9).
Desktop opens KiCad files as detached imports through the open-dialog filter (draw.io precedent, user-QA Q10).
intentionalTradeoffs: Power rails are continuous along every board size and boards cannot rotate (user-QA Q2).
On breadboard pages with a part selected, r rotates instead of selecting the rectangle tool (user-QA Q3).
The push button is open in netlists; SPICE writes it as a comment and IC subcircuits as undefined placeholders (user-QA Q5).
Older builds reject documents with a breadboard page (user-QA Q6).
A freshly imported page fails nodetto-cli lint until every staged part is placed (user-QA Q8, Q9).

Accepted low residuals: PR5-L1 (plan 17 relies on wave order for plan 03 formatters), PR5-L2 (BreadboardExportKind not exported; plan 17 uses an inline union), PR5-L3 (plans 03 and 04 biome-check the shared io index concurrently), PR5-L4 / DR-2 (design 8.3 round-trip wording broader than plan 18 tests).
supportedEdgeCases: Full, half and mini boards; parts with spans and DIP ICs with configurable even pin counts.
Reference designators with trailing ? are unannotated; pasted and new parts are annotated; duplicates are reported and fixable.
Two-pin parts with both legs on one strip, rail +/- short, reversed polarity when determinable, LED without series resistor.
Wires with bend points; wire ends off any hole are reported.
Unknown KiCad tokens are tolerated; malformed, legacy and unknown-symbol inputs yield diagnostics; unsupported symbols become a generic DIP/header part or are skipped with a warning.
Deleting the target netlist card turns parity and the ratsnest off.
Ratsnest and highlights update live during drags because they derive from the store revision.
Mermaid and D2 exports skip breadboard types gracefully.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Hierarchical KiCad sheets, buses and KiCad 5 legacy .sch (reported as diagnostics, not imported).
